author: The Current
description:
Minneapolis high-energy, alt-punk trio Heart to Gold talk about their big upcoming year, including their first-ever headlining gig at First Avenue, upcoming US and Japan tour, and Minnesota Yacht Club Festival slot. Heart to Gold at The Current’s Local Artist of the Month this February 2026.

Guests:
Grant Whiteoak - singer/guitarist
Blake Kuethe - drummer
Jim Kisser - bassist

author: The Current
description:
Watch MJ Lenderman & the Wind play "Rip Torn" from "Manning Fireworks"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube 

In October 2024, MJ Lenderman brought his band The Wind into The Current studio to play songs from "Manning Fireworks," including this one, "Rip Torn." As you'll see in the video, guitarist Jon Samuels finds this song a particular jam. 

Also a shout-out to MJ Lenderman, whose birthday is February 4! 

MJ Lenderman’s 2024 album, "Manning Fireworks," is available on @antirecords.
